column1: # Source ordinal cache and shared block-static declarations/initializers.
# LOC = -(ordinal + unit_epoch * MAXTOK); descriptor and conversions stay shared.
# Descriptors use DC.p/DC.a; each object emits at least eight bytes of BSS.
# Scalar/aggregate/string initialization is cut once into the deferred __init blob.
# INITLIST, STRINGINIT, ASSIGNCV and STOREV remain shared procedures.
